LLM auditresponse for stremio.sh:
<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
The provided `stremio.sh` script is a launcher script for the Stremio application, setting environment variables and conditionally starting a local web server. It sets `SERVER_PATH`, `LC_NUMERIC`, and `ANV_DEBUG` for application compatibility and hardware acceleration. It queries OpenGL information via `glxinfo` to detect NVIDIA graphics and sets the `GSK_RENDERER` environment variable accordingly, which is a legitimate GUI rendering optimization.

The script checks if `stremio-web` is available and, if so, starts it in the background, capturing its PID to terminate it cleanly when the main `stremio` process exits. This behavior is consistent with expected application functionality and local service coordination. All executed binaries (`glxinfo`, `stremio-web`, `stremio`) are referenced via standard system paths, and no code is downloaded or executed from external sources.

There are no signs of obfuscation, data exfiltration, unauthorized network connections, or execution of unsanctioned payloads. The script interacts only with locally installed components and uses common shell constructs for environment setup and process management. All actions serve the stated purpose of running the Stremio application with optimal system integration.
</details>
<evidence>

No malicious behavior detected; standard application launcher script.</summary>
